title: LARF: Learning-aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance
abstract: arXiv:2611.32125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Query-document relevance estimation is a core component of AI-native search systems, where a model must assess whether retrieved documents satisfy users' information needs under complex, multi-dimensional criteria. However, directly applying large language models (LLMs) to this task remains challenging because conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides limited supervision for domain-specific judgment rationales, while standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning (RL) objectives do not explicitly enforce margin separation among adjacent ordinal relevance labels. Moreover, although such reasoning can be useful during training, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is impractical for latency-sensitive online ranking. These challenges make it difficult to resolve ambiguous decision boundaries. translated_title: LARF：面向搜索相关性的学习对齐推理框架
translated_abstract: 查询-文档相关性估计是AI原生搜索系统的核心组成部分，模型需要在复杂的多维度标准下评估检索到的文档是否满足用户的信息需求。然而，直接将大语言模型（LLM）应用于该任务仍具挑战性：传统的监督微调（SFT）对领域特定的判断依据提供的监督有限，而标准的轨迹级强化学习（RL）目标并未显式地在相邻的有序相关性标签之间强制实现边际分离。此外，尽管这类推理在训练阶段可能有用，但思维链推理对于延迟敏感的在线排序来说并不实用。这些挑战使得模糊的决策边界难以被有效解决。我们提出了一个三阶段框架LARF（面向搜索相关性的学习对齐推理框架）：它首先在...上进行冷启动SFT（原文在此处截断，后续内容缺失）。
tldr: 该论文提出了三阶段框架LARF，通过对齐推理学习解决搜索相关性估计中领域判断依据监督不足、相邻有序相关性标签间缺乏边际分离、以及思维链推理无法用于低延迟在线排序的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LARF, a three-stage learning-aligned reasoning framework that tackles limited supervision for domain-specific judgment rationales, the lack of margin separation among adjacent ordinal relevance labels, and the impracticality of chain-of-thought reasoning for latency-sensitive online ranking in search relevance estimation.
